body.prompt: A single early-20th-century English gramophone music player as one freestanding antique object: a dark walnut wood cabinet with paneled doors and a circular turntable platter on top, a large polished brass horn with restrained Art Nouveau floral engraving and gently flared bell, a brass winding crank on the side, brass corner fittings and a small carved leaf motif. Realistic warm worn wood grain, aged brass patina, subtle scratches and plausible furniture construction with natural proportions; approximately 1.65 m tall including the horn. The horn must be a clearly separate volume from the wooden cabinet with a visible flange/seam at its base so it can be separated in Blender later; the turntable and side crank should be visually distinct. Complete horn, cabinet front, back, sides and underside; no records, no loose discs, no separate stand, no table, no room, no person, no text. One freestanding static game prop.
